content:
Hi everyone,

I’m excited to join the Lean community! I am currently working on a project called OneModel All Views (OMAV).

Our goal is to formalise financial geometry and stability models, specifically focusing on the Suture regime (convergence of spot prices toward a geometric attractor) and manifold energy.

I'm a beginner with Mathlib4, especially when it comes to the technicalities of the chain rule and unification in calculus. I'm looking forward to learning from you all and contributing to the ecosystem.

Best,
Evangelos Papadopoulos
